sources.title: Smolder Build Guide: SCORCHED EARTH: 225 Stacks to Glory

passive.name: Dragon Practice
passive.text: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.text: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

spells.name: Achooo!
spells.text: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

spells.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
spells.text: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

spells.name: MMOOOMMMM!
spells.text: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

damage.value: Smolder deals sustained burn damage and can deliver critical-strike nukes.

archetype.value: Smolder is a scaling marksman who fights from the back and focuses on the closest target.

axis.value: Smolder should push side-lane waves only with vision and knowledge of where major threats are.

winCondition.value: Smolder wins by surviving, farming, stacking, and reaching his power spikes.

spikes.why: Smolder’s scaling damage makes patient, front-to-back fighting stronger.
Smolder reaches his final evolution at this threshold.
Smolder's basic abilities deal more damage as he gains stacks.

bait.why: Smolder lacks mobility when E is down, making him vulnerable to being caught.

mistakes.value: Smolder players often force fights before their power spikes instead of farming when behind in stacks.
Smolder players make a mistake when they treat him as a passive scaler who cannot contribute before the late game.
